title: alchemilla sectilis
intro: Alchemilla sectilis, commonly known as Lady's mantle or European lady's mantle, is a perennial plant native to Europe, known for its distinctive, deeply lobed leaves and its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla sectilis include its ability to protect the mucous membranes, reduce fever, and act as a mild astringent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
